analyzed_vuln.description: Heap out-of-bounds read in dwarf_get_rnglist_offset_index_value(): it computes offsetptr = con->rc_offsets_array + (offsetentry_index * con->rc_offset_size) and then READ_UNALIGNED_CK copies offset_len bytes from offsetptr, but does not verify that (offsetentry_index+1)*offset_len stays within the actual loaded .debug_rnglists section buffer. The only guard is offsetentry_index < rc_offset_entry_count, so if rc_offset_entry_count/rc_offset_size metadata parsed from malformed input is inconsistent with section size, _dwarf_memcpy_noswap_bytes reads past the heap allocation.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In fuzz_rng, attacker-controlled ELF/.debug_rnglists data is loaded by dwarf_load_rnglists(), which builds rnglists context fields (including rc_offset_entry_count, rc_offset_size, rc_offsets_array). The harness then iterates e < offset_entry_count from dwarf_get_rnglist_context_basics() and calls dwarf_get_rnglist_offset_index_value(dbg,i,e,...). A crafted file with inflated/invalid offset table metadata causes the computed offsetptr for some e to point at/just beyond the end of the allocated section (67-byte region in ASan report), and the 4-byte READ_UNALIGNED_CK triggers a heap-buffer-overflow read.
